grammar.title: Moreover with 并且
grammar.explanation: 并且 (bìngqiě) links two related actions or facts happening together, meaning "and, moreover, furthermore". It's more formal than 而且 and often joins two verb phrases describing the same subject.

grammar.title: Holding firm with V + 住
grammar.explanation: 住 (zhù) after a verb shows an action makes something stay in place or fixed — "catch and hold, remember firmly, stop". It's a common resultative complement, seen in words like 抓住 (catch hold of) and 记住 (remember firmly).

sentences.zh: 这个消息使大家很紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi shǐ dàjiā hěn jǐnzhāng.

sentences.zh: 这次比赛仅用了十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài jǐn yòng le shí fēnzhōng.
sentences.en: This match took only ten minutes.

sentences.zh: 这件事仅他一个人知道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jǐn tā yī gè rén zhīdào.
sentences.en: Only he alone knows about this matter.

sentences.zh: 我本来想去，但是下雨了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng qù, dànshì xiàyǔ le.
sentences.en: I originally wanted to go, but it rained.

sentences.zh: 他本来是老师，后来做了记者。
sentences.pinyin: Tā běnlái shì lǎoshī, hòulái zuò le jìzhě.
sentences.en: He was originally a teacher, and later became a reporter.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhàopiàn guà zài qiáng shàng.
sentences.en: He hung the photo on the wall.
